# dsh Conversation shell

Source: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/86a402200d95fecef4529d969836f1fe13c6cb0d/packages/client/ui-conversation
Version: 0.2.1-alpha.4. License: MIT, retained in LICENSE.

Local changes: greeting/input translations and product-neutral session-lock wording; semantic data attributes in EmptyHero, ConversationHeader, ConversationContent and InputBar for the PekoPet compact presentation. The original editor, input machine, session binding, queue, tool approvals and question takeover remain unchanged. Build with npm run build:frontend. npm overrides keep the original package identity and settings namespace.
